# Single Click — Bridging People and Verified Businesses

> Single Click is a privacy-first platform that connects people with verified local and digital businesses without sharing personal contact details. Users can post enquiries, chat securely in-app, and get things done — all in one secure platform.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://singleclik.com/): Discover the platform, browse top categories, and download the mobile app.
- [About](https://singleclik.com/about): Learn about our mission to bridge people and verified businesses.
- [Categories](https://singleclik.com/#categories): Explore popular service categories including app development, web development, digital marketing, graphic design, SEO services, and content writing.
- [How It Works](https://singleclik.com/#how-it-works): Post an enquiry, receive responses from verified businesses, chat securely, and close the deal.
- [Privacy](https://singleclik.com/#privacy): Understand how we protect your data with no phone number sharing and secure in-app communication.
- [Testimonials](https://singleclik.com/#testimonials): Read authentic feedback from verified users and business owners.
- [FAQ](https://singleclik.com/#faq): Find answers to common questions about the platform.
- [Contact](https://singleclik.com/#contact): Get in touch with the Single Click team.

## For Businesses

- [Join as Business](https://singleclik.com/#cta): Register your verified business and start receiving quality enquiries.
- [Dashboard](https://singleclik.com/#cta): Manage your business profile, enquiries, and customer interactions.
- [Resources](https://singleclik.com/#resources): Access guides, best practices, and business support materials.
